# Complete Business Plan: Sunrise Brew Coffee House

---

## Executive Summary

Sunrise Brew Coffee House is a premium yet approachable neighborhood coffee shop located in the heart of a growing urban community. Our mission is to provide exceptional coffee beverages and fresh food options in a warm, inviting atmosphere that fosters community connection and repeat patronage.

**Key Objectives:**
- Achieve $450,000 in first-year revenue
- Reach break-even by month 8
- Establish a loyal customer base of 500+ regular patrons
- Expand to a second location within 36 months

**Capital Requirements:** $185,000 initial investment

---

## Company Description

### Business Overview
- **Legal Structure:** LLC (Limited Liability Company)
- **Location:** 1,200 sq. ft. retail space at 742 Maple Avenue, Riverdale District
- **Founded:** Q2 2026
- **Ownership:** Sarah Chen (Founder/CEO), Michael Torres (Co-Owner/Operations)

### Mission Statement
"To serve outstanding coffee and create meaningful moments that bring our community together, one cup at a time."

### Vision
To become the premier specialty coffee destination in the Riverdale District, recognized for quality, consistency, and community engagement.

---

## Market Analysis

### Industry Overview
The U.S. coffee shop industry generates approximately $48 billion annually, with a projected 3.2% annual growth rate. Specialty coffee continues to gain market share as consumers prioritize quality and experience over convenience.

### Target Market
- **Primary:** Adults 25-54 with household income $50,000+
- **Secondary:** College students and young professionals
- **Tertiary:** Remote workers seeking alternative workspaces

### Market Research Findings
- 68% of local residents surveyed indicated they would visit a new coffee shop 3+ times weekly
- Average customer spend: $7.50 per visit
- Peak hours: 7:00-9:00 AM and 12:00-2:00 PM
- 3 competing coffee shops within 1-mile radius

### Competitive Analysis

| Competitor | Strengths | Weaknesses |
|------------|-----------|------------|
| Bean There Café | Established brand, central location | Higher prices, limited seating |
| Daily Grind | Drive-through convenience | Lower quality, fast-food atmosphere |
| Cozy Corner | Loyal following, cozy ambiance | Outdated equipment, slow service |

**Our Competitive Advantage:** Superior product quality, modern atmosphere, extended evening hours, and community-focused programming.

---

## Organization & Management

### Organizational Structure
```
        Founder/CEO
            |
    ┌───────┴───────┐
    │               │
Operations      Marketing
Manager         Manager
    │               │
    └───────┬───────┘
            │
    ┌───────┼───────┐
    │       │       │
Baristas  Kitchen  Front
(4 FT)    Staff    Counter
         (2 FT)   (2 FT)
```

### Management Team

**Sarah Chen – Founder/CEO**
- 12 years in food service management
- Former Regional Manager, Bean There Café
- MBA, Riverdale University

**Michael Torres – Co-Owner/Operations Manager**
- 8 years in hospitality industry
- Certified Q Grader (coffee quality)
- B.S. Hospitality Management, State College

### Staffing Plan
- 4 full-time baristas
- 2 full-time kitchen staff
- 2 full-time front counter associates
- 3 part-time employees for peak coverage
- Total: 13 employees

---

## Service & Product Line

### Core Products

**Coffee Beverages**
| Product | Price | Margin |
|---------|-------|--------|
| Espresso | $3.25 | 72% |
| Americano | $3.50 | 75% |
| Latte | $4.75 | 68% |
| Cappuccino | $4.50 | 70% |
| Cold Brew | $4.95 | 71% |
| Pour-Over | $5.50 | 65% |
| Flavored Lattes | $5.25 | 66% |

**Non-Coffee Beverages**
| Product | Price | Margin |
|---------|-------|--------|
| Hot Tea Selection | $3.25 | 78% |
| Chai Latte | $4.50 | 70% |
| Hot Chocolate | $4.00 | 74% |
| Fresh Smoothies | $6.50 | 62% |
| Italian Soda | $3.75 | 76% |

**Food Items**
| Product | Price | Margin |
|---------|-------|--------|
| Croissants | $3.50 | 55% |
| Breakfast Sandwich | $7.95 | 58% |
| Avocado Toast | $8.95 | 62% |
| Lunch Salad | $9.95 | 64% |
| Fresh Baked Cookies | $2.75 | 52% |
| Energy Bites | $3.25 | 58% |

### Additional Revenue Streams
- Retail coffee beans and accessories (15% of revenue)
- Coffee brewing classes ($45/person, monthly)
- Private event space rental ($150/hour)
- Loyalty program with branded merchandise

---

## Marketing Strategy

### Brand Identity
- **Name:** Sunrise Brew Coffee House
- **Tagline:** "Where Every Cup Tells a Story"
- **Color Palette:** Warm amber, deep espresso brown, cream white
- **Logo:** Stylized sunrise emerging from a coffee cup

### Marketing Channels

**Digital Marketing**
- Instagram, Facebook, TikTok presence
- Google My Business optimization
- Email newsletter (weekly specials)
- Local SEO targeting "coffee near me"

**Traditional Marketing**
- Grand opening event with live music and free tastings
- Flyers in neighborhood businesses and community centers
- Local newspaper feature story
- Business card distribution at nearby offices

**Community Engagement**
- Monthly "Open Mic Night" for local artists
- Partnership with Riverdale Library for story time events
- Support for local school fundraisers
- "Paws & Passports" dog-friendly patio events

### Promotional Strategy
- **Opening Special:** Buy one, get one 50% off (first two weeks)
- **Loyalty Program:** Buy 9 coffees, get 1 free
- **Happy Hour:** 20% off all drinks 2:00-4:00 PM daily
- **Student Discount:** 15% off with valid ID

### Sales Projections
| Month | Projected Customers | Projected Revenue |
|-------|---------------------|-------------------|
| 1-3 | 3,200/month | $24,000/month |
| 4-6 | 4,100/month | $30,750/month |
| 7-12 | 5,000/month | $37,500/month |
| Year 2 | 5,800/month | $43,500/month |

---

## Operations Plan

### Location & Facilities
- 1,200 sq. ft. retail space
- Seating capacity: 45 customers (35 indoor, 10 patio)
- Full kitchen for food preparation
- Dedicated coffee bar with 2 espresso machines
- Ample storage and preparation areas

### Equipment Requirements
- 2 La Marzocco Linea PB espresso machines ($32,000)
- Fetco batch brewer ($2,500)
- Cold brew system ($1,800)
- Refrigeration units ($6,000)
- Kitchen equipment package ($18,000)
- Point-of-sale system ($3,500)
- Furniture and fixtures ($15,000)
- **Total Equipment:** $78,800

### Suppliers
- **Coffee Beans:** Direct trade relationship with Volcanica Coffee Company
- **Dairy:** Local dairy cooperative (supporting local agriculture)
- **Bakery Items:** Fresh daily from Artisan Bread Co.
- **Paper Products:** Sysco Foods distribution
- **Cleaning Supplies:** Commercial janitorial service

### Technology & Systems
- Square POS system for inventory and sales tracking
- Square for Restaurants for table management
- 7shifts scheduling software
- QuickBooks for accounting
- WiFi-enabled environment with customer access

### Health & Safety Compliance
- ServSafe food handler certification for all staff
- Monthly health inspections
- COVID-19 safety protocols (hand sanitizing stations)
- Allergen information readily available

### Hours of Operation
| Day | Hours |
|-----|-------|
| Monday-Friday | 6:30 AM - 9:00 PM |
| Saturday | 7:00 AM - 10:00 PM |
| Sunday | 8:00 AM - 7:00 PM |

---

## Financial Plan

### Startup Costs

| Category | Amount |
|----------|--------|
| Leasehold improvements | $45,000 |
| Equipment purchase | $78,800 |
| Initial inventory | $8,000 |
| Licenses and permits | $3,500 |
| Marketing (launch) | $12,000 |
| Insurance (6 months) | $4,800 |
| Professional services | $5,000 |
| Working capital | $18,000 |
| Contingency fund | $9,900 |
| **Total Startup Costs** | **$185,000** |

### Funding Request
- **Equity Investment:** $100,000 (27% ownership stake)
- **Small Business Loan:** $85,000 at 6.5% interest over 7 years

### Revenue Projections

**Year 1 Monthly Revenue Estimate:**
- Average daily transactions: 145
- Average transaction value: $8.50
- Operating days: 365
- **Projected Year 1 Revenue:** $450,000

**Year 1 Expense Breakdown:**
| Expense Category | Annual Amount |
|-----------------|---------------|
| Rent ($4,500/month) | $54,000 |
| Payroll (13 employees) | $168,000 |
| Cost of Goods Sold | $135,000 |
| Utilities | $14,400 |
| Insurance | $9,600 |
| Marketing | $8,000 |
| Maintenance | $6,000 |
| Professional services | $6,000 |
| Loan payments | $14,500 |
| Miscellaneous | $7,500 |
| **Total Expenses** | **$423,000** |

### Pro Forma Income Statement

| | Year 1 | Year 2 | Year 3 |
|-|--------|--------|--------|
| Revenue | $450,000 | $522,000 | $595,000 |
| COGS | $135,000 | $156,600 | $178,500 |
| Gross Profit | $315,000 | $365,400 | $416,500 |
| Operating Expenses | $288,000 | $302,400 | $317,500 |
| Net Income | $27,000 | $63,000 | $99,000 |
| Net Profit Margin | 6% | 12% | 16.6% |

### Break-Even Analysis
- Fixed Costs: $162,000/year
- Variable Cost per Customer: $5.10
- Average Revenue per Customer: $8.50
- **Break-Even Point:** 47,647 customers or 130 customers/day
- **Projected Break-Even:** Month 8

### Cash Flow Statement (Year 1)

| Quarter | Starting Cash | Net Cash Flow | Ending Cash |
|---------|---------------|---------------|-------------|
| Q1 | $185,000 | ($28,000) | $157,000 |
| Q2 | $157,000 | ($12,000) | $145,000 |
| Q3 | $145,000 | $18,000 | $163,000 |
| Q4 | $163,000 | $49,000 | $212,000 |

---

## Risk Analysis & Mitigation

| Risk | Probability | Impact | Mitigation Strategy |
|------|--------------|--------|---------------------|
| Competition intensifies | Medium | Medium | Continuous quality improvement, loyalty programs |
| Supply chain disruption | Low | High | Maintain 3 supplier relationships, 2-week inventory buffer |
| Staff turnover | Medium | Medium | Competitive wages, positive culture, growth opportunities |
| Economic downturn | Medium | High | Menu flexibility, value offerings, diversified revenue |
| Equipment failure | Low | High | Preventive maintenance schedule, equipment warranty |

---

## Conclusion

Sunrise Brew Coffee House presents a compelling investment opportunity in a growing market with proven demand. Our experienced management team, quality-focused product strategy, and community-centered approach position us for sustainable success.

With your investment of $185,000, we will establish a profitable coffee shop that generates positive returns within the first year and positions us for strategic growth.

**Contact Information:**
Sarah Chen, Founder
sunrisebrew@email.com
(555) 234-5678

---

*This business plan is a hypothetical document for illustrative purposes.*
